verdict.rationale: Otter's enterprise docs directly claim it can "instantly auto-generate follow-up emails" for client calls, and AI Chat is described as helping create follow-ups, so the drafting core of the story is a first-party capability. The review-and-send step is not documented, and all support comes from vendor marketing. missing for 10: documented in-app review/edit and one- or two-click send flow (e.g., email client integration), detail on how drafts are generated and customized, independent or hands-on corroboration of follow-up email quality.

support.subject: As a sales lead, the tool drafts my follow-up email from the meeting so I can review and send it in a couple of clicks

citations.quote: Instantly auto-generate follow-up emails and next steps for client calls,  internal reviews, and more.
Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions and help you create follow-ups, reports, and content.
